App text (English): Enter the rate your SMS provider charges. Messages with local-language letters are spelled in plain letters so each stays one part.
Ichibemba: Lembeni ndalama iyo mulipila pa SMS. Ifilembo fya ciBemba fililembwa mu fyakale ukuti SMS ibe imo.
Chinyanja: Lembani mtengo womwe operekera SMS amalipiritsa. Zilembo zapadera zimalembedwa mwachizolowezi kuti uthenga ukhale gawo limodzi.
Chitonga: Amulembe mulawo ngobabbadelesya SMS. Mabala aaindene alalembwa mu bwaabo kuti SMS ibe cipanzi comwe.
Silozi: Mu ñole tefo ye ba e lefisang ka SMS. Litaba tse ikgethileng li ñolwa ka tse tavalehileng ho ba karolo e le ngwe.
Kikaonde: Lemba mutengo wapanwa na SMS. Bilembwa bya mwa kwamba bilembwa bya bwikazi kuti SMS ibe kipande kimo.
Chilunda: Lembenu mutengo wazeya SMS. Yilembu yakulumbulwila yilembekaña yamwishina kuti SMS yikale chipandu chimu.
Luvale: Soneka mutengo wafweta SMS. Vilembo vyalilimi vilembwa vyamwishina kuti SMS ikale kipande kimu.

App text (English): Entries are permanent and cannot be deleted. To fix a mistake, use Reverse, which adds a correcting entry and keeps the history.
Ichibemba: Ifyalembwa tafumishiwa. Ukulungika ubwafya, shimikeni Bwesha, ilembapo icalembwa cipya.
Chinyanja: Zolembedwa sizichotsedwa. Kukonza cholakwika, gwiritsani Bwezani, yomwe imawonjezera cholembedwa chatsopano.
Chitonga: Zakulembwa tazisulwi. Kugwasya, amubelesye Bweze, ikubikka cakulembwa cipya.
Silozi: Se si ñolilwe ha si tuhelwi. Ku lukisa liphoso, mu sebelise Busa, i eketsa se si nca.
Kikaonde: Bilembwa kechi bifumishiwa. Kuwamisha, sebenzesha Bwezha, kyongela kilembwa kya pya.
Chilunda: Vyakulembeka kavifumishawu. Kulondolola, zatishenu Zeyesha, yilembaku chipya.
Luvale: Vyasonekwa kavifumisiwa. Kuwahisa, tumisa Fwetesa, yinongela chasonekwa chipya.

App text (English): Entries were recorded at this meeting, so it cannot be deleted. Reverse those entries first.
Ichibemba: Ifyalembwa fyalembwa pa kukumana, tacifumishiwa. Bweshani ifyalembwa fyalicibweshiwa.
Chinyanja: Zolembedwa zinalembedwa pa msonkhano uwu, sungachotsedwe. Bwezani zolembedwazo kaye.
Chitonga: Zakulembwa zyakalembwa kumuswaangano ooyu, tawusulwi. Amubweze zakulembwa kusaanguna.
Silozi: Se si ñolilwe se ne si ñolilwe kwa kopano ye, ha e koni ku tuhwa. Mu busise pele.
Kikaonde: Bilembwa byalembwa pa kukumana kuno, kechi kufumishiwa. Bwezha bilembwa kushala.
Chilunda: Vyakulembeka vyalembekawu kuchipompelu cheniki, kachifumishawu. Zeyeshenu vyakulembeka tutwala.
Luvale: Vyasonekwa vyasonekwa kunkunguluko kanou, kafumisiwa. Fwetesa vyasonekwa kutunda.

Silozi: Se si ñolilwe ha si fumanehi

App text (English): Every action, who did it and when. This log is append-only.
Ichibemba: Ifyo bacita, uwaficitile no lilali. Ibuku ili lilembwa fye, talifumishiwa.
Chinyanja: Zochita zonse, amene anazichita ndi liti. Mbiri iyi imangowonjezeredwa.
Chitonga: Zyoonse zyakacitwa, nguni alimwi lili. Rekodi eeyi iyungwa buyo.
Silozi: Ketso kaufela, ya li ketileng ni lili. Buka ye i ekezwa feela.
Kikaonde: Byonse byakanwa, ani ne lilumbi. Rekodi eyi yongelwa fyo.
Chilunda: Vyejima vyazata, njiyi nikwakumbi. Rekodi yeniyi yongeka hohu.
Luvale: Vyosena vyazata, ngweji nalyehi. Rekodi kanou yongelwa hohu.

App text (English): Every contribution recorded. Every member informed.
Ichibemba: Ukusunga konse kulalembwa. Abanyina bonse balishiba.
Chinyanja: Zopereka zonse zalembedwa. Membala aliyense amadziwa.
Chitonga: Kubbadela kuliboonse kulalembwa. Bamembala boonse balizyiba.
Silozi: Ku boloka kaufela ku ñolilwe. Bamemba kaufela ba ziba.
Kikaonde: Kusunga kwa kyonse kulembwa. Bamembala bonse balishiba.
Chilunda: Kusanda kejima kulembekaña. Amembala ejima atela.
Luvale: Kuseka kosena kusonekwa. Vamembala vosena vatachikiza.

App text (English): Every posting sends the member a confirmation. Failed messages can be retried.
Ichibemba: Ifyalembwa fyonse fitumina umwina SMS. Ifilepwa fingeshiwa kabili.
Chinyanja: Cholembedwa chilichonse chimatumiza uthenga kwa membala. Zolephera zimatha kuyesedwa kachiwiri.
Chitonga: Cakulembwa coonse cilatuma SMS kumumembala. Zilemene zilakonzya kweelwa alubo.
Silozi: Se si ñolilwe se si ñwi ni se si ñwi si romela SMS. Tse di hanyehile di ka leka hape.
Kikaonde: Kilembwa kyonse kitumina SMS. Byalema bishashiwa kabiji.
Chilunda: Chakulembeka chejima chitumina SMS. Chalema chakeshawu kapwa.
Luvale: Chasonekwa chosena chituma SMS. Chalemena chesekwa lyehi.

App text (English): Full audit trail of who recorded what, and when
Ichibemba: Ifyalembwa fyonse ifyo umuntu alembele no lilali
Chinyanja: Mbiri yonse ya amene analemba chiyani, ndi liti
Chitonga: Rekodi yoonse yamuntu wakalemba nzi alimwi lili
Silozi: Buka kaufela ya ya ñoliile mang ni lili
Kikaonde: Rekodi yonse ya yalemba bika ne lilumbi
Chilunda: Rekodi yejima yamuntu walemba chika nikwakumbi
Luvale: Rekodi yosena yaze asoneka vika nalyehi

App text (English): Group name, your name and a valid phone are required
Ichibemba: Ishina lya cilimba, ishina lyobe ne feni yalinga fyafwaikwa
Chinyanja: Dzina la gulu, dzina lanu ndi foni yolondola zikufunika
Chitonga: Zina lyacibunga, zina lyanu afoni iili kabotu zyayandika
Silozi: Libizo la sikwata, la mina ni foni e nepahetseng li a hlokahala
Kikaonde: Zhina ya kipwilo, zhina yenu ne foni yawama bifwainwa
Chilunda: Dijina dyachikumbu, dyenu nifoni yawaha yafwana
Luvale: Lizina lyachisaka, lyenu nafoni yawaha vyafwana

App text (English): GroupSave replaces the exercise book with a shared, tamper-evident ledger for your chilimba group, with balances members can check from any phone.
Ichibemba: GroupSave isha mu kubuka kwa mu ncende ukubika ibuku lya ndalama ilingene bonse, ukuti abanyina bamone ndalama shabo pa feni iliyonse.
Chinyanja: GroupSave imalowa m'malo mwa buku la zolemba ndi buku limodzi la gulu lonse, kuti mamembala aone ndalama zawo pa foni iliyonse.
Chitonga: GroupSave ilacinca bbuku lyabulembi aaciindi acibunga cabo, kuti bamembala babone mali aabo kufoni iili yoonse.
Silozi: GroupSave i sebelisa buka e le ngwe ya sikwata kaufela, kuli bamemba ba bone mali a bona ka foni ifi ni ifi.
Kikaonde: GroupSave ilubula buku wa kulemba ne buku umo wa kipwilo kyonse, bamembala bamone mali yabo pa foni yonse.
Chilunda: GroupSave yilombola buku dyimu dyachikumbu chejima, amembala atale mbongo yawu hafoni yejima.
Luvale: GroupSave yinakulwisa buku limwe lyachisaka chosena, vamembala vatale mbongo yavo hafoni yosena.

App text (English): If your number is registered, the code is on its way. It is valid for 10 minutes.
Ichibemba: Nga inambala yobe ilembwa, code iletila. Ilingile imineti 10.
Chinyanja: Ngati nambala yanu yalembetsedwa, khodi ikubwera. Imagwira mphindi 10.
Chitonga: Kuti namba yanu ilembedwe, code ilaboola. Ilabeleka mamineti aali 10.
Silozi: Haiba nomoro ya mina i ñolilwe, khodi i tla. I sebeza metsotso e 10.
Kikaonde: Kuti nambala yenu ilembwa, code ileta. Ikokela maminiti 10.
Chilunda: Neyi nambala yenu yalembekawu, code yikwisa. Yikala mamineti 10.
Luvale: Nge nambala yenu yasonekwa, code yikwiza. Yikala mamineti 10.

Silozi: Khodi ya authenticator ha i nepahali
Lisupo za ku liehela li beilwe

Silozi: Mubeso: {limit}× ya ku boloka ya memba, ku tuha ye a e kolota. Interest {interest}% ({basis}).
Kikaonde: Mupaka: {limit}× kusunga kwa membala, kufumya mwingo wakwete. Interest {interest}% ({basis}).
Chilunda: Mpaka: {limit}× kusanda kwamembala, kufumisha mbongo yakuzeya yakweti. Interest {interest}% ({basis}).
Luvale: Mpaka: {limit}× kuseka kwamembala, kufumisa chilanga akweti. Interest {interest}% ({basis}).

Silozi: Koloto e filwe. Memba u rometswe SMS.
Chilunda: Mbongo yakuzeya yapanawu. Membala watumbi SMS.

App text (English): Members choose their own language when they first dial, and can change it any time from the USSD menu (option 6). Officers can also set it here. SMS receipts use the same language.
Ichibemba: Abanyina basala ululimi lwabo pa kutendeka, kabili balashintilila pa USSD (6). Abaleshi nabo balashintilila apa. SMS ikoma mu lulimi lumo.
Chinyanja: Mamembala amasankha chilankhulo akayamba kuimba, ndipo amatha kusintha pa USSD (6). Atsogoleri amatha kusintha apa. SMS imakhala chimodzimodzi.
Chitonga: Bamembala balisala ciyaluulo cabo, alimwi balakucincinya pa USSD (6). Basilutwe balakucincinya aano. SMS ilaboola muciyaluulo comwe.
Silozi: Bamemba ba itiba puo ya bona, mi ba ka fetola ka USSD (6). Batahisi ba ka i fetola mona. SMS i ba ka puo e swana.
Kikaonde: Bamembala basala mwa kwamba, kabiji bashinja pa USSD (6). Bakulumpe bashinja pano. SMS yaya mu mwa kwamba umo.
Chilunda: Amembala asakula mwakulumbulwila, kaha ashinjika hakukumbuka USSD (6). Atuleñi ashinjika pano. SMS yikwisa mwakulumbulwila mumu.
Luvale: Vamembala vasakula lilimi, kaha vashinjika pa USSD (6). Vatwamina vashinjika apa. SMS yikwiza lilimi limwe.

App text (English): Members flag entries from their phone (USSD option 4). Resolution notes are kept as history.
Ichibemba: Abanyina bapusha ifyalembwa pa feni (USSD 4). Ifyo bapwishisha filasungwa.
Chinyanja: Mamembala amafunsa zolembedwa pa foni (USSD 4). Zigamulo zimasungidwa.
Chitonga: Bamembala balabuzya cakulembwa kufoni (USSD 4). Zisinizyo zilabambilwa.
Silozi: Bamemba ba botisa ka foni (USSD 4). Likalafo li bolokwa.
Kikaonde: Bamembala bapula bilembwa pa foni (USSD 4). Bipwisho bisungwa.
Chilunda: Amembala adiwula chakulembeka hafoni (USSD 4). Yakukumisha yasungawu.
Luvale: Vamembala vapwa vyasonekwa hafoni (USSD 4). Mpwisho yasekwa.

Kikaonde: Mukanda kechi waboneka nangwa ucheshi kutumwa
Luvale: Mujimbu kuhana kuhwanika nyi uchili kutumwa

Ichibemba: Akaunti ya muleshi ifwaya password; mubikeni nga muleshi mupya

App text (English): Online meetings use a private video link that only members of your group receive. Joining marks you present.
Ichibemba: Ukukumana pa intaneti kutumia link ya sunga abena cilimba fye. Ukwingila kulemba ukuti muliko.
Chinyanja: Misonkhano yapaintaneti imagwiritsa ntchito ulalo wachinsinsi wa mamembala a gulu lanu okha. Kulowa kumakulembani kuti mulipo.
Chitonga: Miswaangano yakuinternet ilabelesya link yakusisikizya bamembala bacibunga canu buyo. Kwingila kulamulemba kuti mulipo.
Silozi: Likopano ka inthanete li sebelisa lilinki ya sephiri ya bamemba ba sikwata sa mina feela. Ku kena ku ba ñola ku ba teng.
Kikaonde: Kukumana pa intaneti kwingila link ya bufwishi ya bamembala ba kipwilo kyenu fyo. Kwingila kulemba kuti muliko.
Chilunda: Michipompelu yaintaneti yizatisha link yakufwika yamembala achikumbu chenu hohu. Kwinjila kukulembaku kuti muwanika.
Luvale: Nkunguluko yaintaneti yizatisa link yakufwika yavamembala vachisaka chenu hohu. Kwingila kukusoneka kuti muliko.

App text (English): Only contributions and fines can be reversed here

Ichibemba: Bikeni SMS ya kushininkisha, mupinde musale umwina. Ifyalembwa tafilembwa mukanashininkisha.

Chilunda: Mbongo yejima yapanawu. Membala watumbi SMS.
Luvale: Mbongo yosena yapeleka. Membala watumwa SMS.

App text (English): Preview for the group to approve. Payouts are split in proportion to {basis} and always add up exactly to the pool.
Ichibemba: Ulolesho ukuti icilimba cipokelele. Ukwabana kulingana na {basis}, kabili kulingana ne ndalama shonse.
Chinyanja: Chitsanzo choti gulu livomereze. Logawana limagawidwa molingana ndi {basis} ndipo limafanana ndi thumba lonse.
Chitonga: Cikozyanyo cakuti cibunga cizumine. Kupekezya kulabeleka kweelana a {basis}, alimwi kulafwaanana acisaka coonse.
Silozi: Pono ya hore sikwata si e amohele. Ku aanya ku latelana ni {basis} mi ku lekana ni setulo kaufela.
Kikaonde: Kulangulula kwa kipwilo kuzumine. Kupana kwanyana na {basis}, kabiji kwanyana ne mali yonse.
Chilunda: Kutala kwachikumbu kuzumine. Kupana kwanyana na {basis}, kaha kwanyana nambongo yejima.
Luvale: Kutala chisaka chizumine. Kwabana kuwana na {basis}, kaha kuwana nambongo yosena.

Chinyanja: Ndalama yoyamba iyenera kukhala ngwee yabwino
Silozi: Mali a pili a tlameha ho ba ngwee
Kikaonde: Mali ya kusanguka yafwainwa kuba ngwee

App text (English): Print a member statement for a meeting, or export the whole ledger to a spreadsheet.
Ichibemba: Sindika ifyalembwa fya umwina pa kukumana, nelyo mutume ibuku lyonse.
Chinyanja: Sindikizani statement ya membala pa msonkhano, kapena tumizani buku lonse ku spreadsheet.
Chitonga: Amukatile statement yamumembala kumuswaangano, naa mutume bbuku lyoonse.
Silozi: Mu hatise statement ya memba kwa kopano, kamba mu romele buka kaufela.
Kikaonde: Sindika statement ya membala pa kukumana, nangwa tuma buku yonse.
Chilunda: Sindikenu statement yamembala kuchipompelu, anyi tumenu buku dyejima.
Luvale: Sindika statement yamembala kunkunguluko, nyi tuma buku lyosena.

App text (English): Protects the ledger even if your password is stolen. Works with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy.
Ichibemba: Isunga ibuku nangu password yobe yaibwa. Ikwanisha na Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator nelyo Authy.
Chinyanja: Imateteza buku ngakhale password yanu itabedwe. Imagwira ndi Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator kapena Authy.
Chitonga: Ilakwabilila bbuku nokuba kuti password yanu yabbwa. Ilabeleka a Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator naa Authy.
Silozi: I sireletsa buka le haiba password ya mina i utswitswe. I sebeza ni Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator kamba Authy.
Kikaonde: Ilinda buku nangwa password yenu yabiwa. Yoba na Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator nangwa Authy.
Chilunda: Yikinga buku nangwa password yenu yawuma. Yikwata nakuzata na Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator anyi Authy.
Luvale: Yikinga buku nangwa password yenu yawiwa. Yizata na Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator nyi Authy.

App text (English): Reason for rejecting (shown to the member)
Silozi: Lebaka la ho hana (le bonts'oa memba)
Ke ka lebaka la eng ha mu busa se?

App text (English): Receipt not found, or already posted to the ledger
Silozi: Rasiti ha e fumanehi kamba e se e ñolilwe
Kikaonde: Rasiti kechi yaboneka nangwa yalembwa kale
Luvale: Rasiti kuhana kuhwanika nyi yasonekwa kale

App text (English): Record who attended. Absence fines post automatically and members get an SMS.
Ichibemba: Landeni abaleshibwa. Ifine lya kubula lilemba fye, abanyina balatambula SMS.
Chinyanja: Lembani amene analipo. Zindapusa zosapezeka zimalowa zokha, mamembala amalandira SMS.
Chitonga: Amulembe aabo bakaliko. Milango yakutaboneka ilalembwa alike, bamembala balatambula SMS.
Silozi: Mu ñole ba ba bile teng. Lisupo za ku ba sa teng li ñolwa ka bolona, bamemba ba fumana SMS.
Kikaonde: Lemba bakiliko. Ifine ya kubula yalembwa yeni, bamembala bapokelela SMS.
Chilunda: Lembenu atwesi. Ifine yakuhana yilembekaña yeni, amembala apokolela SMS.
Luvale: Soneka vaze valiko. Ifine yakuhana yisonekwa yene, vamembala vapokola SMS.

Silozi: Mu ñole sikwata se si nca

App text (English): Reminder sent by SMS to all members
Ichibemba: Icibukisho catumwa pa SMS kuli bonse
Chinyanja: Chikumbutso chatumizidwa ndi SMS kwa mamembala onse
Chitonga: Cikumbuzyo catumwa a SMS kubamembala boonse
Silozi: Sikumbuso si rometswe ka SMS ku bamemba kaufela
Kikaonde: Kukumbusha kwatumwa na SMS kwa bamembala bonse
Chilunda: Chikumbuso chatumbi naSMS kudi amembala ejima
Luvale: Chikumbuso chatumwa naSMS kuli vamembala vosena

App text (English): Reminders: loan payments are reminded automatically the day before they are due.
Ichibemba: Ifibukisho: ukulipila inkongole kulatumwa fye bushiku bumo kumbele.
Chinyanja: Zikumbutso: malipiro a ngongole amakumbutsidwa okha tsiku limodzi lisanafike.
Chitonga: Zikumbuzyo: kubbadela ngongole kulakumbuzigwa alikke buzuba bumwi kumbele.
Silozi: Lisehopotso: ku busa koloto ku hopotswa ka bolona letsatsi le le ñwi pele.
Kikaonde: Kukumbusha: kulipila mwingo kwatumwa yeni dyubo dimo kutwala.
Chilunda: Vikumbuso: kuzeya mbongo kutumbwa yeni dehi dimu kutunda.
Luvale: Vikumbuso: kufweta chilanga kutumwa vene chisuku chimwe kutunda.

Silozi: Mali a ku busa ka Kwacha (a šetile {amount})
Ku sinyehana (mali ku muñwi ni muñwi)

App text (English): Rules are fixed when a cycle opens; changes apply to the next cycle.
Ichibemba: Amafunde yasungwa inshiku shatendeka; ukushintilila kuya ku nshiku shilefwaya.
Chinyanja: Malamulo amakhazikika nthawi ikatsegulidwa; kusintha kumagwira nthawi yotsatira.
Chitonga: Milawo ilakwabililwa nsaka yatalika; kucinca kulabeleka nsaka itobelela.
Silozi: Melao i tiya ha nako i buliwa; liphetoho li sebeza nakong e latelezi.
Kikaonde: Mizhilo yabula nshiku yatendeka; kushinja kwafika nshiku yakonkapo.
Chilunda: Mizhi yikala nsañu yatachikisha; kushinjika kwikala nsañu yakonkelaku.
Luvale: Mizhilo yikala nyaka yatachika; kushinjika kuyenda nyaka yakukonda.

App text (English): Rules: {contribution} {frequency}; interest {interest}% per period ({basis}); loan limit {limit}× savings; late fine {fine}; share-out by {shareout}.
Ichibemba: Amafunde: {contribution} {frequency}; inzala {interest}% pa nshiku ({basis}); umupaka wa nkongole {limit}× ukusunga; ifine {fine}; ukwabana kwa {shareout}.
Chinyanja: Malamulo: {contribution} {frequency}; chiwongola dzanja {interest}% pa nthawi ({basis}); malire a ngongole {limit}× zosungidwa; chindapusa {fine}; logawana ndi {shareout}.
Chitonga: Milawo: {contribution} {frequency}; interest {interest}% {basis}; mupaka wangongole {limit}× kubbadela; cilango {fine}; kupekezya {shareout}.
Silozi: Melao: {contribution} {frequency}; interest {interest}% ({basis}); mubeso wa koloto {limit}× ku boloka; sisupo {fine}; ku aanya {shareout}.
Kikaonde: Mizhilo: {contribution} {frequency}; interest {interest}% ({basis}); mupaka wa mwingo {limit}× kusunga; ifine {fine}; kupana {shareout}.
Chilunda: Mizhi: {contribution} {frequency}; interest {interest}% ({basis}); mpaka wambongo yakuzeya {limit}× kusanda; ifine {fine}; kupana {shareout}.
Luvale: Mizhilo: {contribution} {frequency}; interest {interest}% ({basis}); mpaka wachilanga {limit}× kuseka; ifine {fine}; kwabana {shareout}.

App text (English): Scan the code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code below.
Ichibemba: Sikenani code na app ya authenticator, mulembe code ya manambala 6.
Chinyanja: Sikenani khodi ndi app yanu ya authenticator, kenako lembani khodi ya manambala 6.
Chitonga: Amusikene code aapu yanu ya authenticator, mulembe code yamanamba 6.
Silozi: Mu skene khodi ka app ya authenticator, mi mu ñole khodi ya linomoro li 6.
Kikaonde: Sikena code na app ya authenticator, lemba code ya manambala 6.
Chilunda: Sikenu code naapu yenu yaauthenticator, lembenu code yamanambala 6.
Luvale: Sikena code naapu yenu yaauthenticator, soneka code yamanambala 6.

App text (English): Settle all active loans before closing the cycle
Ichibemba: Lipilani inkongole shonse pa kutendeka ukupwisha inshiku
Chitonga: Amubbadele ngongole zyoonse kumbele lyakumana nsaka
Silozi: Mu life likoloto kaufela pele mu nota nako
Kikaonde: Lipila mwingo yonse kushalafye kupwisha nshiku
Chilunda: Zeyenu mbongo yakuzeya yejima kutwala kukumisha nsañu
Luvale: Fweta vilanga vyosena kutunda kuhwisa nyaka

App text (English): Signed in as {name}. Sessions end after 15 minutes of inactivity.
Ichibemba: Mwingile nga {name}. Ukwingila kupwa panuma ya mineti 15 ukubula ukubomba.
Chinyanja: Mwalowa ngati {name}. Gawo limatha pakadutsa mphindi 15 osachita kanthu.
Silozi: U kene jwalo ka {name}. Nako i fela ka metsotso e 15 ha ku si na ketso.
Kikaonde: Mwingila {name}. Kwingila kupwa panyuma ya maminiti 15.
Luvale: Mwingila {name}. Kwingila kuhwa mamineti 15 kuhana kuzata.

App text (English): SMS receipt with a verification code for every entry
Ichibemba: Ukupokelela kwa SMS ne code ya kushininkisha pa cintu conse
Chinyanja: Chiphaso cha SMS ndi khodi yotsimikizira pa cholembedwa chilichonse
Chitonga: Cisinizyo ca SMS acode yakusinizya kucakulembwa coonse
Silozi: Rasiti ya SMS ni khodi ya ku tiyisa ka se si ñolilwe se si ñwi ni se si ñwi
Kikaonde: Rasiti ya SMS ne code ya kusuminisha pa kilembwa kyonse
Chilunda: Rasiti ya SMS ne code yakutondolola pachakulembeka chejima
Luvale: Rasiti ya SMS na code yakusimbwila pachasonekwa chosena

App text (English): Status must be upheld or rejected
Ichibemba: Imibele ifwile ukuba cavomelwa nelyo cakanwa
Chinyanja: Mkhalidwe uyenera kukhala chavomerezedwa kapena chakanidwa
Chitonga: Mbwaabede ziyandika kuba zizuminwe naa zikaanwa
Silozi: Maemo a tlameha ho ba a tiyisitsweng kamba a hanilweng
Kikaonde: Mikalile ifwainwa kuba kyazuminwa nangwa kyakanwa
Chilunda: Mwikalilu welela kwikala chazumino anyi chakanawu
Luvale: Mukwakwo winahase kuwana chazuminwa nyi chakanwa

App text (English): That code is not valid. Check your phone clock and try again.
Ichibemba: Code iyi taikwanisha. Moneni ni nshiku pa feni, esheni kabili.
Chinyanja: Khodi iyi siyolondola. Onani nthawi ya foni yanu, yesaninso.
Chitonga: Code eeyi tiikonzyi. Amulange ciindi kufoni, amweelele.
Silozi: Khodi ye ha i nepahali. Mu talime nako ya foni, mu leke hape.
Kikaonde: Code eyi kechi yawama. Langa nshiku pa foni, eshaiko kabiji.
Chilunda: Code yeniyi kayiwaha. Talenu nsañu hafoni, eshenu kapwa.
Luvale: Code kanou kuhana kuwaha. Tala nyaka hafoni, eseka lyehi.

App text (English): That code is wrong or has expired
Chinyanja: Khodi iyi ndi yolakwika kapena yatha
Silozi: Khodi ye ha i nepahali kamba e fedile

App text (English): That phone number is already registered
Silozi: Nomoro ye e se e ñolilwe

App text (English): The code beside each entry should match the code in the SMS you received for it.
Ichibemba: Code iyo mwabona pa cintu conse yalingile ukulingana ne mu SMS iyo mwapokelele.
Chinyanja: Khodi yomwe ili pafupi ndi cholembedwa chilichonse iyenera kufanana ndi yomwe munalandira mu SMS.
Chitonga: Code iili afwiini acakulembwa coonse ilayandika kufwaanana acode mu SMS njomwakatambula.
Silozi: Khodi ye li pela ni se si ñwi ni se si ñwi i swanela ku tokana ni ya SMS ye mu e fumaneng.
Kikaonde: Code ya pa kilembwa kyonse yafwainwa kunyana ne ya mu SMS yapokelwa nenu.
Chilunda: Code yidi hakachakulembeka chejima yelela kwanyana nayamuSMS yapokolwa nenu.
Luvale: Code yili hacasonekwa chosena yelela kuwana namuSMS yapokola nenu.

Silozi: Setulo se na le ngwee tse {n} feela

App text (English): This meeting already has a payout
Chinyanja: Msonkhano uwu uli kale ndi malipiro
Silozi: Kopano ye e se e na ni ku aanya

App text (English): This member has already received their turn this cycle
Ichibemba: Uyu umwina alapokelela kale mu nshiku
Chinyanja: Membala ameneyu wapeza kale gawo lake
Silozi: Memba yo o se a amohetse

App text (English): This member has ledger history, so they cannot be deleted. Mark them as exited instead.
Ichibemba: Uyu umwina ali na ifyalembwa, tafumishiwa. Mulembeni nga afumapo.
Chinyanja: Membala ameneyu ali ndi zolembedwa, sangachotsedwe. Mumulembe kuti wachoka.
Chitonga: Mumembala ooyu ulijisi zakulembwa, tasulwi. Amumulembe kuti wazwa.
Silozi: Memba yo o na ni se si ñolilwe, ha a koni ku tuhwa. Mu mo ñole jwalo ka ya tsweng.
Kikaonde: Membala yu ali na bilembwa, kechi wafumishiwa. Mumulembe kuti wafuma.
Chilunda: Membala yoyu weti vyakulembeka, kafumishawu. Mumulembenu kuti wafumu.
Luvale: Membala kanou weli navyasonekwa, kafumisiwa. Mumusoneke kuti wafuma.

App text (English): This request has already been decided
Too many attempts. Try again later.
Ichibemba: Mwesha amalila ayengi. Esheni pa numa.
Silozi: Le leke makhetlo a mangata. Le leke hape kamuso.

App text (English): Turn on two-factor sign-in to protect your account
Silozi: Mu bulele two-factor ho sireletsa akaunti

App text (English): Type must be contribution or fine
Ichibemba: Ifyalembwa fifwile ukuba ukusunga nelyo ifine
Chinyanja: Mtundu uyenera kukhala chopereka kapena chindapusa
Chitonga: Mulimo uyandika kuba kubbadela naa cilango
Silozi: Mofuta o tlameha ho ba ku boloka kamba sisupo
Kikaonde: Mushindo ufwainwa kuba kusunga nangwa ifine
Chilunda: Mushindu welela kwikala kusanda anyi ifine
Luvale: Mushindo winahase kuwana kuseka nyi ifine

App text (English): Use a different number or resend
Ichibemba: Ubomfya inambala imbi nelyo ukutuma kabili
Chitonga: Amubelesye namba imbi naa kutuma alubo
Silozi: Mu sebelise nomoro e ñwi kamba mu romele hape
Kikaonde: Sebenzesha nambala imbi nangwa tuma kabiji
Chilunda: Zatishenu nambala yikwabo anyi tumenu kapwa
Luvale: Tumisa nambala yimwe nyi tuma lyehi

App text (English): Valid start and end dates are required
Ichibemba: Inshiku shalinga sha kutendeka no kupwa shafwaikwa
Chinyanja: Masiku oyambira ndi omaliza olondola akufunika
Chitonga: Mabuzuba aali kabotu aakutalika akumana ayandika
Silozi: Mabaka a ku simolola ni ku fela a a nepahetseng a a hlokahala

App text (English): We send a one-time code by SMS to your phone. No password needed.
Ichibemba: Tukutuma code imo ku feni yobe pa SMS. Takwaba password.
Chinyanja: Tikutumizirani khodi yogwiritsa ntchito kamodzi pa SMS. Simufuna password.
Chitonga: Tulamutumina code yaciindi comwe kufoni yanu. Takuyandika password.
Silozi: Re ka le romela khodi ya lila le le li ñwi ka SMS. Ha ku hatulwi password.
Kikaonde: Tukutuma code umo pa foni yenu. Kechi mufwaina password.
Chilunda: Twakutuma code yimu hafoni yenu. Kakuli password.
Luvale: Tunakutuma code yimwe hafoni yenu. Kuhana password.

Silozi: Foni kamba password ha i nepahali

Silozi: U na ni kope e emetseng qeto
Ha ku na se se secha.
